title: Position Map · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Position Map · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Arrange three objects on a table so none overlap. The lead sketches their positions as simple symbols without moving the objects. The sketch preserves the objects' relative positions. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three household objects and paper; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Position Map, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The sketch preserves the objects' relative positions.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The sketch preserves the objects' relative positions.

game.materials: Three household objects and paper; a timer
